% A report with minitoc's mini tables of contents, figures, and tables,
% and its part tables, beside the numbered files of an earlier build that
% loaded xcolor: each entry has \textcolor, and xcolor is not loaded here.
% minitoc writes these files in minitoc's own format, with no line that
% starts with "\contentsline {", and no .aux names them. The .mtc2 of the
% second chapter holds only an \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which
% this document does not define, and the .mtc3 of the third chapter holds
% only a coffee line, which minitoc writes for \addcontentsline{toc}{coffee}
% with no \contentsline. Under tex4ht, \parttoc, \partlof, and
% \partlot read the files of index 0, so the stale .ptc1, .plf1, and
% .plt1 are guards. The stale files stay as they are.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{minitoc}
\begin{document}
\dominitoc
\dominilof
\dominilot
\doparttoc
\dopartlof
\dopartlot
\tableofcontents
\listoffigures
\listoftables
\part{First part}
\parttoc
\partlof
\partlot
\chapter{First}
\minitoc
\minilof
\minilot
Text of the first chapter.
\section{New section}
Text of the section.
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering A figure.
\caption{New figure}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
\centering A table.
\caption{New table}
\end{table}
\chapter{Second}
\minitoc
Text of the second chapter.
\section{Another new section}
Text of the other section.
\chapter{Third}
\minitoc
Text of the third chapter.
\end{document}
